text:
- There is a circular diagram at the top left showing a lifecycle with five stages labeled "DESIGN AND SOURCE", "MAKE", "PACKAGE AND SHIP", "USE", and "RECOVER", each with an associated icon.
- There are six circular images representing materials, each with a text label:
  - An image of aluminum, labeled "Aluminum. We use 100 percent recycled aluminum in the stand."
  - An image of copper, labeled "Copper. We use 100 percent recycled copper in multiple printed circuit boards. We also use 100 percent recycled copper in multiple thermal module components.14"
  - An image of gold, labeled "Gold. We use 100 percent recycled gold in the plating of multiple printed circuit boards."
  - An image of plastic, labeled "Plastic. We use at least 50 percent recycled plastic in 13 components."
  - An image of rare earth elements, labeled "Rare earth elements. We use 100 percent recycled rare earth elements in all magnets, representing 99 percent of the total rare earth elements in the device."
  - An image of tin, labeled "Tin. We use 100 percent recycled tin in the solder of multiple printed circuit boards."
- At the bottom left, there is an image showing various chemical and material samples, such as grey metal pieces, white powders, and liquid droplets.
